note: Privately run campground in the Dore Lake Recreation Site, in the woods behind the long sand beach on Michel Point. Grassy sites; some have sewer, and the water hookups are raw (non-potable) water. Free boat launch; bait, ice and fuel sold; ATV and snowmobile routes nearby. Takes nightly, monthly and seasonal campers and rents a cabin; book by phone or Facebook Messenger. --Claude
